text:
marc: incident-bot just paged: SLO breach on /v1/generate — p95 up to 1.8s, p99 ~3.9s, streaming stalls reported by a few customers. tagging eng-sre and eng-ml
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1841234567 - Latency spike: multiple backends reporting tail stalls. Auto-rollback attempted on recent quant profile rollout for fp8->int8 variants. Paging oncall.
jia: I'm on it. seeing a spike correlated with recent precision-profile rollout 2026-03-13T03:00Z — calibration job failed on ~12% of shards, KV cache flushes increased.
nana: which customers are impacted? any CS tickets?
ravi: Customer-Alert: two high-traffic tenants reported streaming stalls and aborted connections. throughput stable but tok/s dropped during stall windows.
marc: quick snapshot: traces show spike at token 200-280, decoder stalls waiting on dequant path. p50 unaffected, p95/p99 ballooning.
lydia: tentative root: the int8 fallback path triggers heavy dequant CPU work when calibration hits NaNs. Happens on long-context streams.
jia: logs: ```ERROR calib: scale factor NaN at layer 12 shard-8
WARN kvcache: eviction due to stalled step\``` 
marc: can we throttle the new profile per-pool? rollback per-pool? deploy-bot can roll back global but prefer targeted.
deploy-bot: Rolling back precision-profile mixed-int8 for pool-west-1 in 2m. Will trigger canary.
nana: I'm coordinating with CS to notify affected customers: message draft ready, pending scope.
ravi: mitigation checklist:
- rollback profile for affected pools (deploy-bot)
- route streaming to non-quantized variant (routing rule)
- increase kv cache eviction threshold
- re-run calibration with more samples (avoid NaNs)
- create alert for future NaN spikes
marc: Jia, can you run a quick script to re-route active streams to safe model? e.g., set route override for tenant IDs A12,B77
jia: doing route override now: `curl -XPOST /ops/routing/override -d '{"tenants":["A12","B77"],"target":"fp16-safe"}'` — applied.
marc: confirm telemetry: within 60s p95 dropped to 420ms, p99 down to 720ms for those tenants :thumbsup: 
lydia: still seeing stalled traces on some older sessions — likely stuck in server-side request pipeline. need to evict problematic ephemerals.
jia: evicting sessions for tenants A12,B77: `POST /sessions/evict` -> 153 sessions terminated gracefully.
incident-bot: Post-mitigation check: p95 region=west-1 0.43s, p99 0.93s; global p99 still 1.4s due to other canary shards.
marc: next actions: abort remaining canary for profile v3-int8, schedule controlled re-calibration with fallback guard, add NaN detector to calibration job, and create playbook.
nana: CS notified customers with ETA 2h for full remediation. letting them know we rolled back and routed to fp16-safe. keeping them updated.
ravi: adding on-call handoff notes: if any reappearance after 1h, escalate to eng-ml and infra. paging list: @jia, @marc, @lydia, @nana.
marc: handoff to night oncall @lydia in 30m. leave runbook entries:
- incident id: 1841234567
- root cause: calibration fallout produced NaNs in int8 quant table -> dequant stalls under long context streams
- mitigation: targeted rollback, route override, session eviction
- next steps: fix calibration robustness, add synthetic long-context tests, tighten canary policy
lydia: acknowledged. creating follow-up ticket ML-4722 for calibration fixes and ML-ops-189 for canary policy.
deploy-bot: Completed rollback for pool-west-1. Canary aborted. No further config changes.
marc: closing preliminary incident thread. will re-open if metrics cross thresholds. nice work everyone :party_parrot: 
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1841234567 status=resolved (prelim) — monitoring 2h
